description: Set up migration branch and update Supabase client configuration. Enable session persistence and auto-refresh tokens in the Supabase client, which is required before migrating auth. Also update the Database types to include the tables currently only in Firestore (push_tokens, admin_audit_logs, wallets, transactions, posts, likes, comments, stories, follows, notifications, unread_counts, saves, coin_purchases, payment_settings, verification_requests, coin_topups, virtual_world_applications, onboarding_sessions, error_logs, conversations, usernames, email_accounts, config).
steps: Create and switch to branch feat/migrate-firebase-to-supabase from the current branch
Update src/integrations/supabase/client.ts: set persistSession: true, autoRefreshToken: true, detectSessionInUrl: true

Extend src/types/supabase.ts to add type definitions for the Firestore collections being migrated: posts, likes, comments, stories, follows, notifications, unread_counts, saves, wallets, transactions, coin_purchases, coin_topups, payment_settings, verification_requests, virtual_world_applications, onboarding_sessions, push_tokens, admin_audit_logs, error_logs, conversations, messages, usernames, email_accounts, config. Base the field definitions on what the existing Firestore code reads/writes.
Run bunx tsc --noEmit to validate the types compile
acceptance_criteria: New branch feat/migrate-firebase-to-supabase exists and is checked out
Supabase client has persistSession: true and autoRefreshToken: true
src/types/supabase.ts compiles without errors and includes type definitions for all migrated tables
bunx tsc --noEmit passes (or has no NEW errors introduced)
verification: Run 'bunx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -c error' and confirm no new type errors introduced
Run 'bun run build' and confirm build succeeds
findings: TypeScript check passes cleanly (no errors). Build succeeds. All 33 tests pass. The test runner exits with code 1 due to a pre-existing tinypool cleanup issue (ReferenceError: Cannot access listeners before initialization) but all tests themselves pass. The supabase.ts file was rewritten to replace old placeholder table defs with Firestore-aligned schemas per the migration spec. Field names updated to match Firestore usage (e.g. like_count not likes_count, total not balance for wallets, read not is_read for notifications, member_ids array for conversations).
